title: Cell-type signatures of Alzheimer's disease shared across population groups.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Queried the Synapse REST API (Synapse is Sage Bionetworks' data repository): syn53649093 is a Dataset entity 'AMP-AD Diverse Cohorts 10x Multiome Data' listing 14,423 file items. A sample file (syn51757645, the biospecimen metadata CSV, version note 'add 749 10x multiome samples') carries two access requirements: an ADKP (AD Knowledge Portal) clickwrap and a Managed ACT (Access and Compliance Team) requirement, i.e. a reviewed Data Use Agreement. The Shiny browser timed out on HEAD.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The data availability statement says raw fastq and processed count tables/cluster identities are on the AD Knowledge Portal and 'available by submitting a Data Use Agreement through Synapse, requesting access to AMP AD data'. Cohort design (Latin, white, African American donors; ROSMAP, MARS, Latino Core), snRNA-seq plus snATAC-seq, and the disease associations come from the abstract. Supplement listing was not retrievable (Europe PMC timeout).

a1_downloadable.note: Controlled access: the Synapse files carry a Managed ACT Data Use Agreement requirement (AD Knowledge Portal / AMP AD), verified via the API. Paper confirms a DUA is needed for raw and processed data. Access can take weeks.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked (files locked). Donor-level clinical labels (diagnosis, cognition, pathology) are in ROSMAP/Diverse Cohorts metadata, also behind the DUA; would need a join to per-cell counts.

a5_enough_rows.note: Unit of prediction would be the donor; donor count not verified (one metadata file notes 749 multiome samples, which are samples, not donors).

a6_fits_laptop.note: Not checked; single-nucleus count matrices for hundreds of samples are likely many GB.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not checked; clinical diagnosis and neuropathology would be measured labels, but the paper's six patient subgroups are clustering outputs, not usable as labels.

backbone.name: scGPT / Geneformer (single-cell foundation models) would fit if data were accessible
backbone.licence: AMP AD Data Use Agreement governs the data

honest_claim_h3: Not evaluated; the data cannot be downloaded without an approved Data Use Agreement.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use per-donor brain cell-type gene expression to predict Alzheimer's cognitive impairment, testing whether it transfers across ancestry groups.
plain_idea.train_on: Single-nucleus gene expression summarised per donor and cell type from post-mortem cortex of Latin, white and African American donors; donor count unknown (files locked).
plain_idea.predict: Ante-mortem cognitive diagnosis or neuropathology scores recorded by the Rush cohorts (ROSMAP, MARS, Latino Core Study).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would show whether disease signatures learned in one ancestry group predict impairment in another, which matters for diverse-cohort Alzheimer's research.

ml_idea: Donor-level classifier of cognitive impairment from cell-type pseudobulk expression, trained on one population group and tested on the others; blocked by controlled access.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Synapse access requirement on the data files: confirmed Managed ACT Data Use Agreement.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: all raw and processed data sit on the AD Knowledge Portal behind a Managed ACT Data Use Agreement (verified on a Synapse file via the API). Flag as controlled access (Synapse/AMP AD); revisit only if a DUA is approved.
